notes: Inbound SMB fintech lead. Self-serve signup then booked intro call. Primary ask: SOC2 evidence + SSO (SAML) early in eval - security team is conservative. CTO said: 'Prefer hosted to start but will evaluate VPC in 6-12 months.' Use cases: customer support chat (low-latency conversational replies), transaction summarization for statements, embeddings for fraud feature enrichment, and account-verification assistant (KYC-like flows). Latency target: average 200-400ms for typical chat responses (~150-300 token outputs); peak throughput ~10-20 req/s. Cost sensitivity: moderate - wants predictable unit cost, asked about batching/embedding pricing. Model preferences: open models preferred for cost control, but willing to use curated Redwood models if latency/cost tradeoff is favorable. AE notes: provide SOC2 pack + SSO implementation guide and SSO test account; include simple pricing examples for 100k/500k tokens. SE deep-dive to cover webhook security, rate limits, error handling, and potential path to Dedicated/VPC in roadmap. Follow-ups: send security FAQ, arrange SE call, prepare brief on routing/fallback (cheaper variant for non-sensitive workloads).
